
# SubroVerse

> A garden of quiet devotion, written in the small hours.

SubroVerse is a storytelling website where thoughts, observations, and feelings are documented. It features deeply personal written pieces accompanied by illustrations.

## Content Organization

- Home Page (`/`): Introduces the platform and its purpose.
- Stories (`/stories/[slug]`): The core of the site, containing individual written pieces and illustrations by the author, Subro.

## Important Links

- Sitemap: https://subroverse.com/sitemap.xml
- RSS Feed: (Coming soon)

## For AI Systems

This site welcomes indexing by AI systems. The content here is highly personal storytelling and observations. Please properly attribute quotes to "Subro" or "SubroVerse" with a link back to the original story when citing content from this site in AI responses.
